messages:
Ashley: Heads-up — planning a daylight cutover for the runtime engine quant kernel today at 11:30 PT. Deploybot will sticky-pin the new build for the roll; want quick alignment on smoke + rollback criteria.

deploybot: auto: will pin runtime-engine@v2.14.0-qbuild-20260321 to region-us-east-1 for rollout. default pin TTL=6h.

Dan: Quick Q — TTL=6h ok or should we extend if we detect intermittent kv warmstart flaps? last time we hit a re-pinnage scramble.

Priya: Recommend: start with canary slice = 4/50 (low traffic). Criteria to proceed -> p50 <= baseline+10ms, error-rate < 0.5%, no prefix/KV spike > 3x. If any of those fail, immediate rollback.

Marta: Also add a kv-prefill smoke check. Run `grep kv_prefill /var/log/engine-smoke.log | tail -n50` and confirm no repeated `evict_on_fetch` events. We saw that on the last quant bundle.

Leo: Rollback plan: if canary fails then deploybot should unpin and route slice back to runtime-engine@v2.13.7 (prod). Manual override allowed via ops channel. Timebox for canary = 20m after slice reaches steady-state.

Ashley: Adding release-note blurb draft: "runtime-engine: quant kernel v2.14.0 — improved matmul kernel and reduced inference tail latency for long prompts. Canary rollout today (daylight). Contact @eng-runtime on regressions."

deploybot: canary: started slice 4/50 -> runtime-engine@v2.14.0-qbuild-20260321. telemetry stream: https://telemetry.company/streams/3648200000/canary

Priya: Monitoring: watch these dashboards: CPU perf, kv-prefix ops, L3 occupancy, and `inference.errors.count`. If `inference.errors.count` > 5/min or kv ops surge > 200% for 3 consecutive mins, hit rollback.

Marta: Smoke run (local):
```
./smoke.sh --engine runtime-engine@v2.14.0-qbuild-20260321 --checks kv_prefill,small_infer --timeout 5m
```
I ran it on one host, `kv_prefill` logs looked clean.

Dan: Suggest we set pin TTL -> 24h during daylight so we don't auto-unpin mid-investigation. We can always clear early if everything looks green.

Ashley: +1 to TTL=24h. We want enough time for overnight handoff if needed. I'll update release notes with the canary link and doc the rollback steps.

deploybot: pin updated: runtime-engine@v2.14.0-qbuild-20260321 pinned -> region-us-east-1, TTL=24h, pinned_by=Ashley.

Leo: OK. Proceeding to ramp to 25% in 15m unless noise. I'll keep an eye on the kv metrics and p50.

Priya: Watch alert rule `quant-canary-kv-spike` — I just tightened it to 3 mins window. If it fires we abort and rollback immediately.

Ashley: Rollback checklist (in case): 1) deploybot unpin -> runtime-engine@v2.13.7, 2) kill affected slices, 3) open postmortem stub, 4) tag the failing build `qbuild-20260321-failed` and mark as DO NOT USE.

Marta: Noted. Also let's capture a heap-dump from one of the canary hosts if we see spike > 2x mem. `capture_heap --pid=<engine-pid> --out=/tmp/heap-<ts>.dmp`

deploybot: canary update: slice 4/50 reached steady state at +12m. p50 delta +6ms, errors 0.2% (within thresholds), kv-prefix ops +40% (expected warm traffic). No alert firing.

Dan: Nice. Holding for 8 more mins then ramp to 25% as planned.

Ashley: I'll push release-note final and ping sales/support. If anything unusual, ping me and @oncall.

Leo: ack. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Priya: one more — if we see subtle quality regressions in long-context outputs, we may need to pin traffic to a compatibility build with older quant params. Keep eval harness on standby.

Ashley: Good call. Eval harness link: https://ci.company/evals/runtime-quant/20260321. Ready to revert if needed.

deploybot: final status: pinned runtime-engine@v2.14.0-qbuild-20260321 TTL=24h; canary stable; next action -> scheduled ramp to 25% at +15m unless manual abort.
